feed.headline: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
feed.ai: Some cities including Lyon and Nice have banned all protests, and the French president said only authorised demos would be allowed.

feed.headline: Watch: Will Ukraine get the support needed as tensions with US rise?
feed.ai: Zelensky thanked the "real leaders" ahead of a meeting with the EU in Brussels.

feed.headline: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
feed.ai: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

feed.headline: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
feed.ai: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.

feed.headline: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
feed.ai: Rioting, looting and vandalism has gripped France over the weekend after protests spiralled out of control across the country.

feed.headline: Serbian Election Underscores the Region’s Long Political Limbo
feed.ai: Aleksandar Vucic, Serbia’s dominant political figure since 2012, may extend his grip, using the Balkans’ unresolved nationalist resentments.

feed.headline: Macron Says Trump Does Not Like France and Distorts Its Troubles
feed.ai: Speaking in Qatar, President Emmanuel Macron railed against foreign leaders who he said had made false claims about unrest in France for their own political ends.

feed.headline: UK to Headphone Dodgers on Trains: Shush
feed.ai: Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced a campaign against listening to music or videos without headphones on public transportation. We asked London commuters to weigh in.

feed.headline: Trump Says He Asked Putin to Release an American Jailed in Russia
feed.ai: The president called for the return of Stephen James Hubbard, a Michigan teacher seized from his home in Ukraine months after Russia invaded that country.

feed.headline: Why Zelensky Took the Gloves Off This Time With Trump
feed.ai: Staying quiet is riskier than speaking up, Ukrainian officials say, as President Trump goes further than ever in prioritizing Russia’s interests.

feed.headline: Moment Colombian authorities seize 7.6 tonnes of cocaine bound for Europe
feed.ai: Colombia has seized 7.6 tonnes of cocaine at the port of Cartagena in what President Abelardo de la Espriella described as the country's largest drug seizure in a decade.

feed.headline: Serbia: Student protesters flood Belgrade ahead of snap elections
feed.ai: Cheers, music and waving flags greeted students arriving in Belgrade from across Serbia on Wednesday, as thousands gathered ahead of a final rally before this weekend's snap parliamentary elections.
